symptom: `create layout M.L (layouttype: 'Responsive', folder: 'Layouts')` passed check, and exec refused it: 'unknown property "folder"'.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_layout_v3.go buildLayoutV3 (Folder via pb.resolveFolder) and the rewrite path (applyDocumentFolder when the header names a folder); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe.go describeLayout prints folder:. Test: mdl/executor/layout_folder_2460_test.go
cause: The layout header's allow-list (added to stop silently ignored properties) did not include folder, which pages and snippets take; check does not run the builder, so only exec saw the refusal; and describe never printed a layout's folder, so a round trip would have moved a foldered layout to the module root.
insight: **An allow-list that refuses unknown properties has to list every property its siblings accept, and check must agree with it.** Measured on 11.12.6: created in Layouts/Web, describe prints folder:, describe → exec Unchanged, a changed folder moves the layout, mx check 0 errors.
